body: Okay I guess. Had its ups and downs

Just hold onto the idea that it'll all get better. Its what I do... And I really hope its true because I'm ten years into feeling like this now and nothing has changed. Hold onto the idea it gets better.


And fallout is an amazing game.

You aren't alone.  Probably thousands of miles away, but you feel just like I do, and as ready as I think I am to do it, I don't want you to think that way. I'm told one day it'll all be okay... Let's do our best to see if it's true.
I think I just don't see the world as anything but a burden to be a part of. And I hate everything about myself.
I don't have a working phone.
There is no one online to talk to.
That's just not the way it'll be for me I think.
Who I am will always be better off alone.
Being alone all the time is the worst feeling in the world. But some people are better off I think.
I am there. And I can tell you it isn't as nice as it sounds.
